title: Update result request
description: POST /api/v1/update-results (FR-S.5, ADR 0018, P1-UPDATES). The agent reports how an update ended: it now runs the new version (succeeded), it refused or could not install it (failed), or it went back to the previous version (rolled_back). Retried until accepted, with the same report_id. Exempt from the minimum agent version, so an agent that is too old for the other endpoints can still report. The host is identified by the credential, never by a field in the body.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.

report_id.description: UUIDv4, generated per result and reused on retry so the server can discard duplicates.

rollout_id.description: The rollout_id of the agent_update directive this result answers.

version.description: The release version the directive offered. The server refuses a result whose version is not the rollout's release.

outcome.description: succeeded: the new version authenticated and completed an acknowledged heartbeat. failed: nothing was installed, or the install did not complete. rolled_back: the new version could not confirm and the previous one was restored.

reason.description: Why an update failed or was rolled back: required for those outcomes, plain text, no secrets. Optional (or null) for succeeded.

occurred_at.description: When the outcome was reached (agent clock), RFC 3339 UTC. Stored for display only.
